recommendation: Keep the source fix. No further FHIR core work is needed for FHIR-20521 unless OO reopens the broader policy for condition tags on elements referenced by invariant prose but not directly selected in FHIRPath.
issue_request: FHIR-20521 was an Applied/Persuasive OO issue for R6 reporting that Observation elements involved in obs-7 were not all flagged by ElementDefinition.condition, specifically Observation.code, Observation.value, Observation.component.code, and Observation.component.value; a comment noted Observation.value was already flagged.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-20521 was found. The broader FHIR-24860 cleanup commit 55512f8e09be7228efab289f8bf660242d29654d added obs-7 condition tags to Observation.code, Observation.component, and Observation.component.code while Observation.value[x] already had obs-7, but Observation.component.value[x] still lacked the tag.
additional_context: Observation is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. OO minutes on 2025-01-14 identified Observation.component.value[x] as the remaining missing obs-7 condition, and OO minutes on 2025-05-30 marked FHIR-20521 Persuasive/pre-applied/Applied. FHIR-20319 later resolved no-change for the obs-7 expression, so the expression was left untouched.
reconciliation: Added <condition value="obs-7"/> to source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml on Observation.component.value[x], adjacent to the existing obs-10 condition.

related_jiras.note: Published broader condition-consistency tracker; its cleanup commit partially applied the Observation obs-7 tags.
Later no-change decision on the obs-7 expression confirmed this reconciliation should not alter the FHIRPath.
Related obs-7 wording audit already represented on the combined branch and separate from this condition-tag fix.
Separate applied obs-10 condition-tag cleanup on the same element confirmed the local placement pattern.
